name: What are the key stages involved in building a new restaurant?

mainEntity.name: What are the key stages involved in building a new restaurant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a new restaurant typically involves several stages. Initially, there's planning and design, including architectural drawings, kitchen layout, and interior design. This is followed by permitting, which can be a lengthy process in areas like Los Angeles. Construction phases then begin with site preparation, foundation work, framing, and rough-ins for plumbing, electrical, and HVAC. Finally, interior finishes, kitchen equipment installation, and final inspections complete the project before opening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key stages include planning, design, permitting, site preparation, construction of the structure, installation of systems and equipment, and final finishes.
